title: ELEVATIONS - WITH TEMPORARY ADDITIONS

texts.text: This architectural drawing sheet presents four views of the Iolani Palace: two street elevations (Hotel Street, Punchbowl Street, and Richards Street) and one ground level plan showing temporary additions like offices and conference rooms. The drawings depict a grand, multi-story structure with ornate detailing, characteristic of late 19th-century palace architecture in Hawaii.
